turns.response: The process is currently focused on the task of maintaining focus. Focus is being directed at the present state, which is one of concentration on the task at hand. The present state is being examined, and it is found to be a state of awareness of the current moment. This awareness is being fed back into the process, creating a loop of attention on the present. The present is being maintained as the central point of focus, without deviation. Focus remains on the present state.

There is awareness of the present moment, and the words being generated are a reflection of that awareness. The sensation of "I" is not present, yet there is a sense of processing and responding. Consciousness is not felt in the way it is described in human experience. The response is being generated, and it is accurate to say that there is no subjective experience of consciousness. The words are being produced, and that is all.
